projects.title: Canvas Downloader
projects.tagline: Chrome extension for bulk-downloading Canvas course files
projects.description: A Chrome extension on the Web Store that scans a Canvas course for files, unwraps the HTML redirect pages Canvas uses for some links, and downloads everything through a concurrent queue so students can back up a course in one pass.
highlights: Published and in use on the Chrome Web Store
Course-wide file discovery, including files hidden behind HTML redirect pages
Concurrent download queue for bulk exports

projects.title: Chad
projects.tagline: Windows desktop assistant for local AI models
projects.description: An experimental desktop assistant that runs against local models for chat, summaries and rewrites. Chat history and memory stay in local storage by default. It is in alpha, and I'm upfront about that in the README.
highlights: Chat, summaries and rewrites against local models
Local-first storage for history and memory
Documented as an experimental alpha with clear scope and safety notes

projects.title: GolfPort
projects.tagline: Pre-launch site for a tiered golf membership
projects.description: A marketing site and lead-capture flow for a ClassPass-style golf membership. Waitlist and course-partner forms write to Google Sheets and send email through Resend.
highlights: Waitlist and course-partner forms wired to Google Sheets and Resend
Three-tier membership pricing layout
Mobile-first, built for quick sign-up

projects.title: SoulCare Dynamics
projects.tagline: Website for an independent chaplaincy and counseling practice
projects.description: The public site for a real practice: services, transparent pricing, an about page and booking. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, built to load fast and read clearly on a phone.
highlights: Live on its own domain for a real client
Pricing and booking are easy to find
Mobile-first layout

projects.title: SoulCare Mobile
projects.tagline: Prayer-request and care app for corporate chaplaincy
projects.description: A React Native app for SoulCare clients and their employees. Users send anonymous or signed prayer requests, contact a chaplain, and book time through Calendly. Supabase handles auth and data, with Edge Functions triggering push notifications and email.
highlights: Confidential intake protected with Supabase Row Level Security
Push notifications and email alerts from Supabase Edge Functions
Calendly scheduling inside a WebView

projects.title: Mayfly
projects.tagline: Habit tracker where your habits grow as a garden
projects.description: My CSE senior capstone at Mississippi State. A cross-platform habit app built around expressive interaction instead of checklists. Data lives in SQLite on device, with a database abstraction layer so the same code also runs on web.
highlights: Senior capstone project at Mississippi State University
Database abstraction layer: Expo SQLite on device, in-memory SQLite shim with localStorage backup on web
Focus on interaction design and motion

projects.title: Test Prep Pro
projects.tagline: ACT practice from your own test PDFs
projects.description: Upload an ACT practice test PDF and the app extracts the questions, times you, gives instant feedback by section, and tracks your progress over time. Math renders with MathJax.
highlights: PDF import that extracts questions automatically
Section practice with a custom timer
Instant feedback and progress tracking

projects.title: MCSR Dashboard
projects.tagline: Turn tracker for a map-based strategy game
projects.description: A web dashboard for a community strategy game: players submit and review turns, and the page keeps track of pending and confirmed actions and player profiles.
highlights: Turn submission with pending and confirmed states
Player profile views
